close_reason: Extracted parse_base_url helper. JmapClient::new now reads as four facts (parse, validate config, build transport, construct Self) rather than a six-step inline procedure. Validation rules + PASS/FAIL examples in the helper's doc-comment. No public-API change; existing tests pass.
description: src/client.rs:151-197 — the constructor does six sequential validation passes (empty / parse / scheme / path / query / fragment / config.validate / build_client) inline before constructing Self. The validations are correct but the function reads as a procedure rather than 'parse, don't validate'. Idiomatic alternative: a private `fn parse_base_url(s: &str) -> Result<url::Url, ClientError>` returning a fully-validated Url, called from new() as one expression. Combined with config.validate() into a single 'preflight' step, the constructor body shrinks to ~5 lines. Note: locked crate.
title: JmapClient::new validation logic is 30+ lines of stringy URL checks
